name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 58 – Am 62
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 58. Affirms that unanimity for decisions in the European Council, the Council of Ministers and EU agencies, such as the European Defence Agency, remains vital to ensure Member States’ sovereignty over defence policy and that the neutrality of certain Member States is respected;
